content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for MAHE Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 12-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Manipal Academy of Higher Education (MAHE) for project-based research positions.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available in MAHE recruitment?
faq.answer: The available posts are Project Research Scientist-I (Project manager) and Project Technical Support-III under an ICMR study.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are announced in total?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies available across the designated project research and technical support positions.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your detailed curriculum vitae via email or post is October 12, 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply by sending their detailed CV and documents via email to [email protected] or by post.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for Project Research Scientist-I?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for Project Research Scientist-I will receive a salary of Rs. 56,000 plus 10% HRA.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for Project Technical Support-III?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for Project Technical Support-III will receive a salary of Rs. 28,000 plus 10% HRA.

faq.question: Q8. What is the maximum age limit to apply?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants across all posts is 35 years.

faq.question: Q9. What qualifications are needed for Project Technical Support-III?
faq.answer: Applicants must possess a three years graduate degree with three years of post-qualification experience or a postgraduate degree in relevant disciplines.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for MAHE positions?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of eligible candidates followed by a formal interview round.
